summary: Current working sheet for Q2 commitments: 156 reserved GPUs across active customer contracts (mix of H100/A100/L4). Short-term pressure in asia-south1 (StratusMaps) and us-east1 (NuanceFin) due to training and trading peaks. Several starter contracts expire in May–July 2027, creating ~28 GPU potential churn. Headroom estimated at ~12% in primary pools if shared bursting is allowed; tight (<5%) for enterprise H100 slices. Recommend prioritizing H100 capacity replenishment and firming up renewal conversations for contracts ending May–July.
